_comment: Story genres: the curated story tags. A submitted story needs at least one of them (backend/story_genres.py); authors may add any other words too, which the story list shows under 'other'. The review page draws them with these colours and the icons in public/icons/tag-<id>.png.

genres.desc: Graphic violence and viscera. Not for the squeamish.
Fights, duels and battles — blades drawn and blood spilled.
Monsters and wild creatures — the hunt, the lair, the maw.
Werewolves and shapeshifters — the beast within, cursed by the moon.
Villainy and malice — dark powers, cruelty and the foe's own schemes.
Skeletons, ghosts and the risen dead; graves that don't stay shut.
Spells, enchantment and the arcane; sorcerers, rituals and runes.
Chance and destiny — dice, fortune and the turning of the wheel.
Visions and prophecy — seers, omens and glimpses of what comes.
Dread and the supernatural — things that stalk the dark.
Dark portents — curses foretold and signs of ill fortune.
Secrets, clues and investigation; a whodunit to unravel.
Loot, hoards and glittering reward — greed and its consequences.
Riddles, locks, traps and clever problem-solving over brute force.
Cunning and mischief — cons, disguises and clever deceit.
Armoured foes, sieges and holding the line — defence over daring.
Sneaking and infiltration — shadows, silent blades and not being seen.
Grand journeys of danger and discovery across the land.
Long roads and wilderness treks — the journey matters as much as the goal.
Scarcity and the elements: shelter, hunger, cold and keeping alive.
Torch-lit crawls through crypts, caverns and the dark below.
Ancient artefacts — lost relics of power and the ruins that hide them.
Oceans, rivers and voyages — waves, ships and what swims beneath.
Peaks, cliffs and high passes — thin air and long, hard climbs.
Caverns and tunnels — tight, dark spaces beneath the world.
Tropics, jungles and far shores — palm, sand and distant isles.
Flame and ash — burning, pyromancy, scorched-earth peril.
Cold, frost and snow; frozen wastes and chilling peril.
Humour, wit and absurdity — a tale told with a grin.
Courtly intrigue — nobles, politics, scheming and the throne.
Song and story — minstrels, legends and a tale well told.
Loss, doom and sorrow; endings that are meant to hurt.
Courtship and attraction; a budding romance, matters of the heart.
Deep affection and devotion — love that drives the whole tale.
Explicit intimacy and desire. Adult content — mature readers only.
Vampires and blood nobility — seduction, hunger and the long night.
Any you wish — a catch-all for a theme no other tag captures.
